	return {

		back = ps and ps.back and ps.back.id,

	return InventoryService:Give(player, id)

function InventoryService:_throw(player: Player, charge: number?): boolean
	local _, root = charOf(player)
	return root ~= nil and doThrow(player, root.CFrame.LookVector, charge or 1)
end

function InventoryService:_fumble(player: Player)
	fumble(player)
end

function InventoryService:_reel(player: Player, reel: BasePart?): boolean
	local r = reel
	if not r then
		local truck = ownedTruck(player)
		r = truck and reelOfTruck(truck) or nil
		if not r then
			for _, t in CollectionService:GetTagged(Names.Tag.TruckRefill) do
				if t:IsA("BasePart") and t:IsDescendantOf(workspace) then
					r = t
					break
				end
			end
		end
	end
	if not r then
		return false
	end
	local _, root = charOf(player)
	if root and not Net.near(player, r.Position, Cfg.ReelReturnDistance) then
		root.CFrame = CFrame.new(r.Position + Vector3.new(0, 3, 6))
	end
	onReel(player, r)
	return InventoryService:GetHand(player) == "Hose"
end

function InventoryService:_hydrant(player: Player, hydrant: BasePart)
	onHydrant(player, hydrant)
end

function InventoryService:_selftest(): (boolean, string)
	local net = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("Net")
	local ns = net and net:FindFirstChild("Inventory")
	for _, r in { "Drop", "Throw", "Swap", "Fx" } do
		if not (ns and ns:FindFirstChild(r)) then
			return false, `Inventory/{r} remote missing`
		end
	end
	for id in ItemDefs.Items do
		local m = ItemProps.build(id, "world")
		local ok = m.PrimaryPart ~= nil and m.PrimaryPart.Name == "Handle"
		m:Destroy()
		if not ok then
			return false, `ItemProps {id} has no Handle`
		end
	end
	local tool = services.ToolService
	if tool and type(tool.CreateTool) == "function" then
		local t = tool:CreateTool("Hose", nil)
		local ok = typeof(t) == "Instance" and t:IsA("Tool")
		if typeof(t) == "Instance" then
			t:Destroy()
		end
		if not ok then
			return false, "ToolService:CreateTool(Axe) gave no Tool"
		end
	end
	return true, "ok"
end

return InventoryService

# Lessons
## Design
- The base place is empty: build the map from code (Instance.new Parts, Anchored = true, parented to Workspace).
- Make every acceptance-critical object reachable and in range: keep doors, pickups and victims within tool range of walkable floor, and leave gaps wide enough for the character to pass.
- Lay out props so they never overlap or z-fight. Do not place coplanar surfaces (a pad on a road, a road on a road) at the same Y; offset them by at least 0.05 studs or use different thicknesses. Place buildings outside road footprints with a margin, and keep door pads on walkable ground. Place repeated props (houses, pads) on a deterministic grid or in lanes with explicit road exclusion zones and minimum spacing, not random ring angles. A ring of props around a hub collides with roads that cross the same area, so compute positions from the road layout. Also keep the spawn and key landmarks clear of each other and of the roads, and keep the spawn-to-first-objective distance short.

-- Remotes: Inventory/Drop, Inventory/Throw, Inventory/Swap, Inventory/Fx
-- Counters: inv_grabs, inv_drops, inv_throws, inv_bonks, inv_fumbles, inv_swaps, inv_hose_out,
--   inv_hose_stowed, inv_supply_lines, inv_supply_snaps, inv_props_carried, inv_restocks
-- Test hooks: _selftest(), _state(player), _give(player, id), _throw(player, charge?),
--   _fumble(player), _reel(player, reel?), _hydrant(player, hydrant)

local CollectionService = game:GetService("CollectionService")
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local ServerScriptService = game:GetService("ServerScriptService")

local Shared = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Shared")
local Signal = require(Shared:WaitForChild("Signal") :: ModuleScript)
local Net = require(Shared:WaitForChild("Net") :: ModuleScript)
local Popup = require(Shared:WaitForChild("Popup") :: ModuleScript)
local Names = require(Shared:WaitForChild("Names") :: ModuleScript)
local Telemetry = require(ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("ForgeTelemetry") :: ModuleScript) :: any
local ConfigFolder = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Config")
local Cfg = require(ConfigFolder:WaitForChild("InventoryConfig") :: ModuleScript) :: any
local ToolConfig = require(ConfigFolder:WaitForChild("ToolConfig") :: ModuleScript) :: any
local ItemDefs = require(ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Lib"):WaitForChild("Items"):WaitForChild("ItemDefs") :: ModuleScript) :: any
local ItemProps = require(ServerScriptService:WaitForChild("Lib"):WaitForChild("Items"):WaitForChild("ItemProps") :: ModuleScript) :: any

local InventoryService = {}
InventoryService.Priority = 55
InventoryService.Changed = Signal.new() :: any
InventoryService.Bonked = Signal.new() :: any
InventoryService.Fumbled = Signal.new() :: any

local TAG_ITEM = "InventoryItem"
local TAG_RACK = "GearRack"
local TAG_COMPARTMENT = "TruckCompartment"
local ATTR_PROMPT = "InvPrompt"

type Data = { foam: number?, air: number?, reel: BasePart? }
type Held = { id: string, data: Data }
type PState = {
	hand: Held?,
	back: Held?,
	carry: Instance?,
	tool: Tool?,
	toolFor: Held?,
	backModel: Model?,
	backFor: Held?,
	lastNotify: number,
}

local services: { [string]: any } = {}
local states: { [Player]: PState } = {}
local loose: { [Model]: { id: string, data: Data, born: number } } = {}
local looseOrder: { Model } = {}
local flyers: { { part: BasePart, thrower: Player, born: number, hit: { [Player]: boolean }, what: string } } = {}
local stockHooked: { [Instance]: boolean } = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" }) :: any
local promptHooked: { [Instance]: boolean } = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" }) :: any
local looseFolder: Folder? = nil
local FxRemote: RemoteEvent? = nil

local function count(name: string, n: number?)
	pcall(function()
		Telemetry.count(name, n or 1)
	end)
end

local function call(serviceName: string, method: string, ...: any): any
	local svc = services[serviceName]
	local f = svc and svc[method]
	if type(f) ~= "function" then
		return nil
	end
	local ok, res = pcall(f, svc, ...)
	if not ok then
		warn(`[InventoryService] {serviceName}:{method} failed: {res}`)
		return nil
	end
	return res
end

local function fx(kind: string, pos: Vector3, text: string?)
	if FxRemote then
		FxRemote:FireAllClients(kind, pos, text or "")
	end
end

local function charOf(player: Player): (Model?, BasePart?, Humanoid?)
	local char = player.Character
	if not char then
		return nil, nil, nil
	end
	local root = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") :: BasePart?
	local hum = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	return char, root, hum
end

local function stateOf(player: Player): PState
	local ps = states[player]
	if not ps then
		ps = { lastNotify = 0 } :: any
		states[player] = ps
	end
	return ps :: PState
end

local function say(player: Player, ps: PState, text: string, kind: string?)
	local now = os.clock()
	if now - ps.lastNotify < 0.8 then
		return
	end
	ps.lastNotify = now
	Popup.show(player, text, kind or "info", player)
end

local function fresh(id: string): Data
	if id == "Extinguisher" then
		return { foam = ToolConfig.FoamSize }
	elseif id == "OxygenTank" then
		return { air = Cfg.OxygenAir }
	end
	return {}
end

local function displayName(id: string): string
	local def = ItemDefs.get(id)
	return if def and def.name then def.name else id
end

local function folder(): Folder
	if looseFolder and looseFolder.Parent then
		return looseFolder
	end
	local f = workspace:FindFirstChild("LooseItems")
	if not f or not f:IsA("Folder") then
		local nf = Instance.new("Folder")
		nf.Name = "LooseItems"
		nf.Parent = workspace
		f = nf
	end
	looseFolder = f :: Folder
	return looseFolder :: Folder
end

-- apply: sync the Tool, back model and attributes to the state ---------------------------------------
local function clearBackModel(ps: PState)
	if ps.backModel then
		ps.backModel:Destroy()
	end
	ps.backModel, ps.backFor = nil, nil
end

local function clearTool(ps: PState)
	if ps.tool then
		ps.tool:Destroy()
	end
	ps.tool, ps.toolFor = nil, nil
end

local function apply(player: Player, ps: PState)
	local char, root = charOf(player)
	-- hand
	if ps.toolFor ~= ps.hand or (ps.tool and not ps.tool.Parent) then
		clearTool(ps)
		if ps.hand and char then
			local t = call("ToolService", "CreateTool", ps.hand.id, nil)
			if typeof(t) == "Instance" and t:IsA("Tool") then
				t.Parent = char
				ps.tool = t
				ps.toolFor = ps.hand
			end
		end
	end
	-- back
	if ps.backFor ~= ps.back or (ps.backModel and not ps.backModel.Parent) then
		clearBackModel(ps)
		if ps.back and char and root then
			local ok, m = pcall(ItemProps.build, ps.back.id, "world")
			if ok and typeof(m) == "Instance" and m:IsA("Model") and m.PrimaryPart then
				for _, d in m:GetDescendants() do
					if d:IsA("BasePart") then
						d.Anchored = false
						d.CanCollide = false
						d.Massless = true
					end
				end
				m:PivotTo(root.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, 0, 0.9))
				local w = Instance.new("WeldConstraint")
				w.Part0 = root
				w.Part1 = m.PrimaryPart
				w.Parent = m.PrimaryPart
				m.Name = "BackItem"
				m.Parent = char
				ps.backModel = m
				ps.backFor = ps.back
			elseif ok and typeof(m) == "Instance" then
				m:Destroy()
			end
		end
	end
	player:SetAttribute("InvHand", if ps.hand then ps.hand.id else "")
	player:SetAttribute("InvBack", if ps.back then ps.back.id else "")
	player:SetAttribute("InvCarry", if ps.carry then ps.carry.Name else "")
	local air = ps.back and ps.back.id == "OxygenTank" and ps.back.data.air or nil
	player:SetAttribute("OxygenAir", air)
	if ps.hand and ps.hand.id == "Extinguisher" then
		player:SetAttribute("Foam", ps.hand.data.foam)
		player:SetAttribute("FoamSize", ToolConfig.FoamSize)
	else
		player:SetAttribute("Foam", nil)
		player:SetAttribute("FoamSize", nil)
	end
	InventoryService.Changed:Fire(player)
end

-- loose items ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
local giveHeld: (Player, Held) -> boolean

local function removeLoose(m: Model)
	loose[m] = nil
	local i = table.find(looseOrder, m)
	if i then
		table.remove(looseOrder, i)
	end
	if m.Parent then
		m:Destroy()
	end
end

local function spawnLoose(held: Held, cf: CFrame, velocity: Vector3?): Model?
	local ok, m = pcall(ItemProps.build, held.id, "world")
	if not ok or typeof(m) ~= "Instance" or not m:IsA("Model") then
		return nil
	end
	local handle = m.PrimaryPart
	if not handle then
		m:Destroy()
		return nil
	end
	for _, d in m:GetDescendants() do
		if d:IsA("BasePart") then
			d.Anchored = false
			d.CanCollide = true
		end
	end
	m:SetAttribute("Item", held.id)
	m:PivotTo(cf)
	CollectionService:AddTag(m, TAG_ITEM)
	loose[m] = { id = held.id, data = held.data, born = os.clock() }
	table.insert(looseOrder, m)

	local prompt = Instance.new("ProximityPrompt")
	prompt.ActionText = "Pick up"
	prompt.ObjectText = displayName(held.id)
	prompt.HoldDuration = 0
	prompt.MaxActivationDistance = 8
	prompt.RequiresLineOfSight = false
	prompt.Style = Enum.ProximityPromptStyle.Custom
	prompt:SetAttribute(ATTR_PROMPT, true)
	prompt.Triggered:Connect(function(player: Player)
		local info = loose[m]
		if not info then
			return
		end
		if giveHeld(player, { id = info.id, data = info.data }) then
			removeLoose(m)
		end
	end)
	prompt.Parent = handle
	m.Parent = folder()
	if velocity then
		handle.AssemblyLinearVelocity = velocity
	end
	return m
end

-- slots ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
giveHeld = function(player: Player, held: Held): boolean
	local ps = stateOf(player)
	if player:GetAttribute(Names.Attr.Downed) == true then
		say(player, ps, "You're down! Can't grab that", "bad")
		return false
	end
	local char = charOf(player)
	if not char then
		return false
	end
	if held.id == "OxygenTank" and not ps.back then
		ps.back = held
	elseif not ps.hand then
		ps.hand = held
	elseif not ps.back and held.id == "OxygenTank" then
		ps.back = held
	else
		say(player, ps, "Your hands are full! (G to drop)", "info")
		return false
	end
	count("inv_grabs", 1)
	if held.id == "Hose" then
		count("inv_hose_out", 1)
	end
	local _, root = charOf(player)
	if root then
		fx("grab", root.Position, displayName(held.id))
	end
	apply(player, ps)
	return true
end

local function releaseProp(player: Player, ps: PState, impulse: Vector3, _unused: any)
	local prop = ps.carry
	ps.carry = nil
	if prop then
		for _, d in prop:GetDescendants() do
			if d:IsA("WeldConstraint") and d.Name == "CarryWeld" then
				d:Destroy()
			elseif d:IsA("BasePart") then
				d.CanCollide = true
				d.Massless = false
			end
		end
		if prop:IsA("BasePart") then
			prop.CanCollide = true
			prop.Massless = false
			prop.AssemblyLinearVelocity = impulse
		end
	end
	apply(player, ps)
end

local function doDrop(player: Player): boolean
	local ps = states[player]
	if not ps then
		return false
	end
	local _, root = charOf(player)
	if not root then
		return false
	end
	if ps.carry then
		releaseProp(player, ps, root.CFrame.LookVector * 6, nil)
		count("inv_drops", 1)
		return true
	end
	local held = ps.hand
	if not held then
		return false
	end
	ps.hand = nil
	apply(player, ps)
	spawnLoose(held, root.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, 0, -3), root.CFrame.LookVector * 4)
	fx("drop", root.Position, displayName(held.id))
	count("inv_drops", 1)
	return true
end

local function doThrow(player: Player, aim: Vector3, charge: number): boolean
	local ps = states[player]
	if not ps or not ps.hand then
		return false
	end
	local _, root = charOf(player)
	if not root then
		return false
	end
	local held = ps.hand
	ps.hand = nil
	apply(player, ps)
	local speed = 30 + 40 * math.clamp(charge, 0, 1)
	local m = spawnLoose(held, CFrame.new(root.Position + Vector3.new(0, 1.5, 0) + aim * 3), aim * speed + Vector3.new(0, 12, 0))
	if m and m.PrimaryPart then
		table.insert(flyers, { part = m.PrimaryPart, thrower = player, born = os.clock(), hit = {}, what = displayName(held.id) })
	end
	fx("throw", root.Position, displayName(held.id))
	count("inv_throws", 1)
	return true
end

local function doSwap(player: Player): boolean
	local ps = states[player]
	if not ps then
		return false
	end
	if not ps.hand and not ps.back then
		return false
	end
	ps.hand, ps.back = ps.back, ps.hand
	count("inv_swaps", 1)
	apply(player, ps)
	return true
end

local function spill(player: Player)
	local ps = states[player]
	if not ps then
		return
	end
	local _, root = charOf(player)
	local pos = if root then root.Position else Vector3.new(0, 5, 0)
	local items = { ps.hand, ps.back }
	if ps.carry then
		releaseProp(player, ps, Vector3.zero, nil)
	end
	ps.hand, ps.back = nil, nil
	clearTool(ps)
	clearBackModel(ps)
	for i, held in items do
		spawnLoose(held, CFrame.new(pos + Vector3.new(i * 2 - 3, 2, 0)), Vector3.new(0, 10, 0))
	end
	player:SetAttribute("InvHand", "")
	player:SetAttribute("InvBack", "")
	player:SetAttribute("OxygenAir", nil)
	InventoryService.Changed:Fire(player)
end

local function fumble(player: Player)
	local ps = states[player]
	if not ps or not ps.hand then
		return
	end
	local held = ps.hand
	ps.hand = nil
	apply(player, ps)
	local _, root = charOf(player)
	if root then
		spawnLoose(held, root.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, 1, -2), Vector3.new(math.random(-8, 8), 12, math.random(-8, 8)))
		fx("fumble", root.Position, displayName(held.id))
	end
	count("inv_fumbles", 1)
	InventoryService.Fumbled:Fire(player, held.id)
end

-- stock (racks, compartments) -------------------------------------------------------------------------
local function stockItemId(inst: Instance, tag: string): string?
	local item = inst:GetAttribute("Item")
	if type(item) == "string" and item ~= "" then
		return item
	end
	if tag == TAG_RACK then
		local slot = inst:GetAttribute("Slot")
		local order = ItemDefs.RackOrder
		if slot ~= nil and type(order) == "table" then
			return order[slot] or order[tonumber(slot) :: number]
		end
	end
	return nil
end

local function hookStock(inst: Instance, tag: string)
	if stockHooked[inst] or not inst:IsA("BasePart") then
		return
	end
	local id = stockItemId(inst, tag)
	if not id or not ItemDefs.get(id) then
		return
	end
	stockHooked[inst] = true
	for _, c in inst:GetChildren() do
		if c:IsA("ProximityPrompt") and c:GetAttribute(ATTR_PROMPT) ~= nil then
			c:Destroy()
		end
	end
	local prompt = Instance.new("ProximityPrompt")
	prompt.ActionText = "Grab"
	prompt.ObjectText = displayName(id)
	prompt.HoldDuration = 0
	prompt.MaxActivationDistance = 10
	prompt.RequiresLineOfSight = false
	prompt.Style = Enum.ProximityPromptStyle.Custom
	prompt:SetAttribute(ATTR_PROMPT, true)
	prompt.Triggered:Connect(function(player: Player)
		InventoryService:Give(player, id)
	end)
	prompt.Parent = inst
end

local function setupTruck(inst: Instance)
	if not inst:IsA("Model") then
		return
	end
	if #CollectionService:GetTagged(TAG_COMPARTMENT) > 0 then
		local has = false
		for _, d in inst:GetDescendants() do
			if CollectionService:HasTag(d, TAG_COMPARTMENT) then
				has = true
				break
			end
		end
		if has then
			return
		end
	end
	for _, d in inst:GetDescendants() do
		if d:IsA("BasePart") and string.sub(d.Name, 1, 7) == "Locker_" then
			CollectionService:AddTag(d, TAG_COMPARTMENT)
		end
	end
end

local function ownedTruck(player: Player): Model?
	for _, t in CollectionService:GetTagged(Names.Tag.Truck) do
		if t:IsA("Model") and t:GetAttribute("OwnerUserId") == player.UserId then
			return t
		end
	end
	return nil
end

local function reelOfTruck(truck: Model): BasePart?
	for _, d in truck:GetDescendants() do
		if d:IsA("BasePart") and CollectionService:HasTag(d, Names.Tag.TruckRefill) then
			return d
		end
	end
	return nil
end

local function onReel(player: Player, reel: BasePart)
	local ps = stateOf(player)
	if ps.hand and ps.hand.id == "Hose" then
		ps.hand = nil
		count("inv_hose_stowed", 1)
		apply(player, ps)
		return
	end
	giveHeld(player, { id = "Hose", data = { reel = reel } })
end

local function hookReel(inst: Instance)
	if promptHooked[inst] or not inst:IsA("BasePart") then
		return
	end
	promptHooked[inst] = true
	local prompt = Instance.new("ProximityPrompt")
	prompt.ActionText = "Hose"
	prompt.ObjectText = "Hose reel"
	prompt.HoldDuration = 0
	prompt.MaxActivationDistance = 10
	prompt.RequiresLineOfSight = false
	prompt.Style = Enum.ProximityPromptStyle.Custom
	prompt:SetAttribute(ATTR_PROMPT, true)
	prompt.Triggered:Connect(function(player: Player)
		onReel(player, inst)
	end)
	prompt.Parent = inst
end

local function onHydrant(_player: Player, _hydrant: BasePart) end

local function hookHydrant(_inst: Instance) end

local function hookCarryable(inst: Instance)
	if promptHooked[inst] then
		return
	end
	local part: BasePart? = if inst:IsA("BasePart") then inst elseif inst:IsA("Model") then inst.PrimaryPart else nil
	if not part then
		return
	end
	promptHooked[inst] = true
	local prompt = Instance.new("ProximityPrompt")
	prompt.ActionText = "Carry"
	prompt.ObjectText = inst.Name
	prompt.HoldDuration = 0
	prompt.MaxActivationDistance = 8
	prompt.RequiresLineOfSight = false
	prompt.Style = Enum.ProximityPromptStyle.Custom
	prompt:SetAttribute(ATTR_PROMPT, true)
	prompt.Triggered:Connect(function(player: Player)
		local ps = stateOf(player)
		local _, root = charOf(player)
		if ps.carry or ps.hand or not root then
			say(player, ps, "Your arms are full! (G to drop)", "info")
			return
		end
		if ((player:GetAttribute(Names.Attr.Carrying) :: string?) or "") ~= "" then
			return
		end
		ps.carry = inst
		local target: BasePart = part
		target.Anchored = false
		target.CanCollide = false
		target.Massless = true
		target.CFrame = root.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, 0, -2.5)
		local w = Instance.new("WeldConstraint")
		w.Name = "CarryWeld"
		w.Part0 = root
		w.Part1 = target
		w.Parent = target
		count("inv_props_carried", 1)
		apply(player, ps)
	end)
	prompt.Parent = part
end

-- ticks ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
local function bonkTick()
	local now = os.clock()
	for i = #flyers, 1, -1 do
		local f = flyers[i]
		if now - f.born > 3 or not f.part.Parent then
			table.remove(flyers, i)
		else
			for _, p in Players:GetPlayers() do
				if p ~= f.thrower and not f.hit[p] then
					local _, root = charOf(p)
					if root and (root.Position - f.part.Position).Magnitude < 3.5 then
						f.hit[p] = true
						count("inv_bonks", 1)
						fx("bonk", root.Position, f.what)
						InventoryService.Bonked:Fire(f.thrower, p, f.what)
					end
				end
			end
		end
	end
end

local function oxygenTick()
	for player, ps in states do
		local tank = ps.back
		if not tank or tank.id ~= "OxygenTank" then
			continue
		end
		local air = tank.data.air or 0
		if air <= 0 then
			continue
		end
		local heat = tonumber(call("HeatService", "GetHeat", player)) or 0
		if heat > Cfg.OxygenMinHeat then
			call("HeatService", "Cool", player, Cfg.OxygenCool, nil)
			tank.data.air = math.max(0, air - 1)
			player:SetAttribute("OxygenAir", tank.data.air)
			if (tank.data.air :: number) <= 0 then
				Net.notify(player, "Your oxygen tank ran dry!", "bad")
			end
		end
	end
end

local function upkeepLoop()
	while true do
		task.wait(1)
		oxygenTick()
		local now = os.clock()
		for i = #looseOrder, 1, -1 do
			local m = looseOrder[i]
			local info = loose[m]
			local handle = m.PrimaryPart
			if not info or not m.Parent or not handle or not handle.Parent then
				removeLoose(m)
			elseif now - info.born > Cfg.LooseSeconds then
				removeLoose(m)
			end
		end
	end
end

-- players --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
local function hookCharacter(player: Player, char: Model)
	local ps = stateOf(player)
	if ps.carry then
		releaseProp(player, ps, Vector3.zero, nil)
	end
	ps.tool, ps.toolFor, ps.backModel, ps.backFor = nil, nil, nil, nil
	char:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart", 10)
	apply(player, ps)
	local hum = char:WaitForChild("Humanoid", 10) :: Humanoid?
	if hum then
		hum.Died:Connect(function()
			if player.Character == char then
				spill(player)
			end
		end)
	end
	char:GetAttributeChangedSignal(Names.Attr.Ragdolled):Connect(function()
		if char:GetAttribute(Names.Attr.Ragdolled) == true and player.Character == char then
			fumble(player)
		end
	end)
end

local function hookPlayer(player: Player)
	stateOf(player)
	player.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(char: Model)
		hookCharacter(player, char)
	end)
	if player.Character then
		task.spawn(hookCharacter, player, player.Character)
	end
	player:GetAttributeChangedSignal(Names.Attr.Carrying):Connect(function()
		local ps = states[player]
		if ps and ps.carry and ((player:GetAttribute(Names.Attr.Carrying) :: string?) or "") ~= "" then
			releaseProp(player, ps, Vector3.new(0, 4, 0), nil)
		end
	end)
	local backpack = player:WaitForChild("Backpack", 10)
	if backpack then
		backpack.ChildAdded:Connect(function(child: Instance)
			local ps = states[player]
			if ps and child == ps.tool and player.Character then
				task.defer(function()
					if child.Parent == backpack and player.Character then
						child.Parent = player.Character
					end
				end)
			end
		end)
	end
end

local function watchTag(tag: string, fn: (Instance) -> ())
	CollectionService:GetInstanceAddedSignal(tag):Connect(function(inst: Instance)
		task.defer(fn, inst)
	end)
	for _, inst in CollectionService:GetTagged(tag) do
		task.spawn(fn, inst)
	end
end

local function onWaterUsed(player: Player, ...: any)
	local ps = states[player]
	if ps and ps.hand and ps.hand.id == "Extinguisher" then
		local foam = ps.hand.data.foam or 0
		ps.hand.data.foam = math.max(0, foam - 1)
		player:SetAttribute("Foam", ps.hand.data.foam)
	end
end

-- service --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
function InventoryService:Init(all: { [string]: any })
	services = all
end

function InventoryService:Start()
	FxRemote = Net.event("Inventory", "Fx")
	local DropR = Net.event("Inventory", "Drop")
	local ThrowR = Net.event("Inventory", "Throw")
	local SwapR = Net.event("Inventory", "Swap")
	Net.onServer(DropR, { rate = 4, burst = 2 }, function(player: Player)
		doDrop(player)
	end)
	Net.onServer(ThrowR, { rate = 3, burst = 1 }, function(player: Player, rawAim: any, rawCharge: any)
		local aim = Net.unit(rawAim)
		local charge = if type(rawCharge) == "number" and rawCharge == rawCharge then math.clamp(rawCharge, 0, 1) else 0
		if aim then
			doThrow(player, aim, charge)
		end
	end)
	Net.onServer(SwapR, { rate = 4, burst = 2 }, function(player: Player)
		doSwap(player)
	end)
	folder()

	local tool = services.ToolService
	if tool and tool.WaterUsed then
		tool.WaterUsed:Connect(onWaterUsed)
	end

	watchTag(TAG_RACK, function(inst: Instance)
		hookStock(inst, TAG_RACK)
	end)
	watchTag(TAG_COMPARTMENT, function(inst: Instance)
		hookStock(inst, TAG_COMPARTMENT)
	end)
	watchTag(Names.Tag.Truck, function(inst: Instance)
		task.wait(0.5)
		setupTruck(inst)
	end)
	watchTag(Names.Tag.TruckRefill, hookReel)
	watchTag(Names.Tag.Hydrant, hookHydrant)
	watchTag(Cfg.CarryTag, hookCarryable)

	Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(hookPlayer)
	for _, p in Players:GetPlayers() do
		task.spawn(hookPlayer, p)
	end
	Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(player: Player)
		local ps = states[player]
		if ps then
			if ps.carry then
				releaseProp(player, ps, Vector3.zero, nil)
			end
			clearTool(ps)
			clearBackModel(ps)
		end
		states[player] = nil
	end)

	RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(bonkTick)
	task.spawn(upkeepLoop)
end

function InventoryService:Give(player: Player, itemId: string): boolean
	if not ItemDefs.get(itemId) then
		return false
	end
	local data = fresh(itemId)
	if itemId == "Hose" then
		local truck = ownedTruck(player)
		data.reel = if truck then reelOfTruck(truck) else nil
	end
	return (giveHeld(player, { id = itemId, data = data }))
end

function InventoryService:Drop(player: Player): boolean
	return doDrop(player)
end

function InventoryService:Throw(player: Player, aim: Vector3, charge: number): boolean
	local unit = Net.unit(aim)
	return if unit then doThrow(player, unit, charge) else false
end

function InventoryService:Swap(player: Player): boolean
	return doSwap(player)
end

function InventoryService:GetHand(player: Player): string?
	local ps = states[player]
	return ps and ps.hand and ps.hand.id
end

function InventoryService:GetBack(player: Player): string?
	local ps = states[player]
	return ps and ps.back and ps.back.id
end

function InventoryService:Clear(player: Player)
	local ps = states[player]
	if not ps then
		return
	end
	if ps.carry then
		releaseProp(player, ps, Vector3.zero, nil)
	end
	ps.hand, ps.back = nil, nil
	apply(player, ps)
end

function InventoryService:_state(player: Player): { [string]: any }
	local ps = states[player]
	return {
		hand = ps and ps.hand and ps.hand.id,
		back = ps and ps.back and ps.back.id,
		carry = ps and ps.carry and ps.carry.Name,
		tool = ps and ps.tool and ps.tool.Name,
		loose = #looseOrder,
		flyers = #flyers,
	}
end

function InventoryService:_give(player: Player, id: string): boolean
	return InventoryService:Give(player, id)
end

function InventoryService:_throw(player: Player, charge: number?): boolean
	local _, root = charOf(player)
	return root ~= nil and doThrow(player, root.CFrame.LookVector, charge or 1)
end

function InventoryService:_fumble(player: Player)
	fumble(player)
end

function InventoryService:_reel(player: Player, reel: BasePart?): boolean
	local r = reel
	if not r then
		local truck = ownedTruck(player)
		r = if truck then reelOfTruck(truck) else nil
		if not r then
			for _, t in CollectionService:GetTagged(Names.Tag.TruckRefill) do
				if t:IsA("BasePart") and t:IsDescendantOf(workspace) then
					r = t
					break
				end
			end
		end
	end
	if not r then
		return false
	end
	onReel(player, r)
	return InventoryService:GetHand(player) == "Hose"
end

function InventoryService:_hydrant(player: Player, hydrant: BasePart)
	onHydrant(player, hydrant)
end

function InventoryService:_selftest(): (boolean, string)
	local net = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("Net")
	local ns = net and net:FindFirstChild("Inventory")
	for _, r in { "Drop", "Throw", "Swap", "Fx" } do
		if not (ns and ns:FindFirstChild(r)) then
			return false, `Inventory/{r} remote missing`
		end
	end
	for id in ItemDefs.Items do
		local m = ItemProps.build(id, "world")
		local ok = m.PrimaryPart ~= nil and m.PrimaryPart.Name == "Handle"
		m:Destroy()
		if not ok then
			return false, `ItemProps {id} has no Handle`
		end
	end
	local tool = services.ToolService
	if tool and type(tool.CreateTool) == "function" then
		local t = tool:CreateTool("Hose", nil)
		local ok = typeof(t) == "Instance" and t:IsA("Tool")
		if typeof(t) == "Instance" then
			t:Destroy()
		end
		if not ok then
			return false, "ToolService:CreateTool(Hose) gave no Tool"
		end
	end
	return true, "ok"
end

return InventoryService
